source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: Once per turn, during [your opponent's Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), once an enemy unit has shot, if it made a ranged attack against a **NECRONS** unit of yours up to 3" from one of your models with this ability, one such model up to 3" from that target can then shoot, as it would in [your Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase). Its only legal target is that enemy unit, and it can shoot only while that unit is eligible as a target.

trigger.event: enemy unit targets friendly NECRONS unit
